Regardless of the type of project submitted by the regional center, the regional center would have to submit evidence that the new commercial enterprise is established in the United States, which must include, as appropriate, complete formation documents, such as articles of incorporation, organization, association, certificate of merger or consolidation or other similar formation documents, together with all amendments to such documents; complete copies of all other organizational documents, such as a partnership agreement, operating agreement, bylaws, or other similar organization documents for the new commercial enterprise, together with all amendments to such documents; and certificates evidencing the new commercial enterprise's authority to do business in the State, municipality, or other applicable jurisdiction of the United States in which the new commercial enterprise has created or is seeking to create jobs. See proposed 8 CFR 204.421(a). DHS would expect the regional center to submit documentation of the new commercial enterprise's authority to do business in any location where the new commercial enterprise is principally doing business under proposed 8 CFR 204.401, Principally doing business.
根据拟议规则,区域中心还须就将投资于该新商业企业的每位区域中心投资人提交充分创造就业机会的证据。通常应通过一份经济影响分析报告(EIA)提供,证明该项目将在综合商业计划书所确定的时限内,为每位区域中心投资人创造至少10个合格雇员的全职就业机会。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.421(b)。由于区域中心投资人可依赖间接创造就业机会来满足最多90%的要求,并可依赖经济模型来满足其余10%的直接创造就业机会要求,国土安全部拟要求区域中心采用一种在经济学和统计学上有效且透明的方法,使模型输出结果可重现,且项目申请中须充分说明所有输入数据及对模型所作的任何调整。同上。尽管国土安全部目前预期区域中心提交美国经济分析局的区域投入产出建模系统以证明创造就业机会,但国土安全部拟提出此项措辞,以允许区域中心提交可能更适合该区域中心的其他经济方法,例如,若就业估算是基于租户入住率方法。然而,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)必须能够独立核实该模型的输入与输出数据,同时也须考虑未来可能开发的、同样可能满足“经济学和统计学上有效且透明”要求的新型或修订经济模型。
Under the proposed rule, the regional center would also have to submit evidence of sufficient job creation for each regional center investor that will be investing in the new commercial enterprise. This would typically be provided in an EIA showing that the project will create full-time employment for at least 10 qualifying employees per regional center investor within the timeline identified in the comprehensive business plan. See proposed 8 CFR 204.421(b). Since regional center investors may rely on indirect job creation to establish up to 90 percent of the requirement and may rely on economic models to establish the remaining 10 percent of direct job creation, DHS proposes requiring a regional center to rely on an economically and statistically valid and transparent methodology in which model outputs are reproducible and all the inputs and any adjustments to the model are fully explained in the project application. Id. While DHS currently expects regional centers to submit the Bureau of Economic Analysis' Regional Input-Output Modeling System to establish job creation, DHS proposes this language to allow a regional center to submit other economic methodologies that may work better for the regional center, because, for example, the job estimates are based on a tenant occupancy methodology. USCIS, however, must be able to independently verify the inputs and outputs to the model, while also accounting for any new or modified economic models that may be developed in the future that might also meet the “economically and statistically valid and transparent” requirements.
新商业企业主要经营业务所在的地点将决定区域中心投资人对该新商业企业所需的投资水平。如果项目申请中所确定的新商业企业主要在高失业率地区经营业务,区域中心须提交构成拟议项目区域的人口普查区列表及该地区的失业统计数据,以及获取该失业统计数据所采用的方法,还须提交用于计算该地区是否符合高失业率地区定义所使用的全国失业率。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.421(c)(2);另参见拟议的8 CFR 204.402。同样,如果项目申请中所确定的新商业企业主要在农村地区经营业务,区域中心须提交该新商业企业主要经营业务所在地区的地图,包括该地区的人口数量,以证明该地区符合农村地区的定义。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.421(c)(1);另参见拟议的8 CFR 204.401“农村地区”。对于区域中心提供基础设施项目投资机会的项目,区域中心须提交证据,证明其已与联邦、州、地方或部落机构或当局签订合同,为公共工程项目提供投资资金。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.421(c)(3)。
The location where the new commercial enterprise is principally doing business would determine the level of investment required by regional center investors in the new commercial enterprise. If the new commercial enterprise identified in the project application is principally doing business in a high unemployment area, the regional center would have to submit a list of the census tracts comprising the proposed project area and the unemployment statistics for that area, along with the methods by which the unemployment statistics were obtained, as well as the national unemployment rate used to calculate whether the area meets the definition of a high unemployment area. See proposed 8 CFR 204.421(c)(2); see also proposed 8 CFR 204.402. Similarly, if the new commercial enterprise identified in the project application is principally doing business in a rural area, the regional center would have to submit a map of the area where the new commercial enterprise will principally be doing business, including the population counts of that area to establish that the area meets the definition of a rural area. See proposed 8 CFR 204.421(c)(1); see also proposed 8 CFR 204.401, Rural area. For projects where the regional center is offering an investment opportunity in an infrastructure project, the regional center would have to submit evidence of a contract with a Federal, State, local, or tribal agency or authority to provide investment capital to a public works project. See proposed 8 CFR 204.421(c)(3).
区域中心还必须保留新商业企业的任何投资人与区域中心或其关联实体之间的任何协议，或区域中心（第40721页印刷页）与其关联实体之间与项目申请中所述任何资本转移有关的协议的副本，包括但不限于发售备忘录、认购协议、托管协议、组织文件、条款清单、附函、口头协议的书面记录，以及与该发售有关的已使用或将使用的任何其他营销材料，包括用于或将用于营销或推广EB-5移民签证项目的任何社交媒体平台的标识。见拟议的8 CFR 204.421(d)。美国国土安全部（DHS）提议区域中心保留此类信息，以便在美国公民及移民服务局（USCIS）审计时提交，并提供证据以证明区域中心与其关联实体之间可能存在的任何潜在利益冲突，尤其是与区域中心投资人资本的转移和使用有关的利益冲突。
The regional center would also have to retain a copy of any agreements between any investor in the new commercial enterprise and the regional center or its related entities, or agreements between the regional center ( printed page 40721) and its related entities that relate to the transfer of any capital described in the project application, including, but not limited to, offering memoranda, subscription agreements, escrow agreements, organizational documents, term sheets, side letters, documentation of oral agreements, and any other marketing materials used or to be used in connection with the offering, including the identification of any social media outlets that are or will be used to market or promote the EB-5 immigrant visa program. See proposed 8 CFR 204.421(d). DHS proposes this provision for the regional center to retain such information for submission in connection with a USCIS audit and to provide evidence of any potential conflicts of interest that may exist between the regional center and its associated entities, particularly as related to the transfer and use of regional center investor capital.
《移民与国籍法》（INA）禁止使用移民投资人的资本购买市政债券或任何其他债券，若此类债券可面向公众发行，无论是作为一级发行的一部分还是来自二级市场。见INA第203(b)(5)(E)(v)(II)(bb)条，8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(E)(v)(II)(bb)。美国国土安全部提议明确，该禁止性规定适用于初始投资、托管资本、资本的使用、资本的再部署，以及为使资本持续处于风险之中而对资本的任何持续使用。见拟议的8 CFR 204.427。
The INA precludes the use of immigrant investor capital to purchase municipal, or any other bonds, if they are available to the general public, either as part of a primary offering or from a secondary market. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(E)(v)(II)(bb), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(E)(v)(II)(bb). DHS proposes to clarify that this prohibition applies to an initial investment, capital held in escrow, use of capital, redeployment of capital, and any ongoing use of capital to retain the capital at risk. See proposed 8 CFR 204.427.
区域中心还必须按照拟议的8 CFR 204.417(a)的要求，提交与新商业企业及关联创造就业实体有关人员的证明和信息。见拟议的8 CFR 204.421(e)。
The regional center would also have to submit attestations and information from persons involved with the new commercial enterprise and affiliated job-creating entities as required by proposed 8 CFR 204.417(a). See proposed 8 CFR 204.421(e).
该申请还必须包括证据，以证明新商业企业或关联创造就业实体已按照拟议的8 CFR 204.425的要求设立了独立账户，并已聘请适当的基金管理人，包括此类账户的银行对账单。见拟议的8 CFR 204.421(f)。
The application would also have to include evidence to show that the separate account required under proposed 8 CFR 204.425 has been established by the new commercial enterprise or affiliated job-creating entity and an appropriate fund administrator has been retained, including bank statements for such accounts. See proposed 8 CFR 204.421(f).
最后，区域中心需要提供额外信息，既可以作为附加文件提供，也可以包含在为满足上述要求而提交的文件之中。见拟议的8 CFR 204.421(g)。美国国土安全部提议，所需的额外信息和文件清单应包括：新商业企业及创造就业实体的管理层、高级职员、董事以及任何承担类似职责人员的简历；与该投资相关的风险；向潜在投资人提供的任何投资及发售文件；向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）或任何州证券监管机构提交的与该投资有关的任何文件；当前存在或可能出现的利益冲突；以及在最近十年期间内，在美国境内或境外，涉及该区域中心、新商业企业或创造就业实体，或其所有者、高级职员、经理、董事或以类似身份行事的其他人员，或该等人员持有多数所有权的任何其他企业的任何未决调查、诉讼、破产或不利判决或破产裁定。同上。美国国土安全部认为，上述信息和文件涵盖了监管影响分析（RIA）中所确定的区域中心项目申请作为供区域中心投资人使用的投资发售文件应满足的全部要求。参见，例如，INA第203(b)(5)(F)(i)(III)条和第(IV)条，8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(i)(III)和(IV)。
Lastly, the regional center would need to provide additional information, either as additional documentation or included within documents submitted to establish the requirements above. See proposed 8 CFR 204.421(g). DHS proposes that this list of required additional information and documentation include biographies for management, officers, directors, and any person with similar responsibilities at the new commercial enterprise and job-creating entity(ies); risks associated with the investment; any investment and offering documents provided to potential investors; any documents related to the investment filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) or securities regulator of any State; conflicts of interest that currently exist or may arise; and any pending investigations, litigation, bankruptcy, or adverse judgments or bankruptcy orders issued during the most recent 10-year period, in the United States or abroad, involving the regional center, new commercial enterprise, or job-creating entity(ies), or its owners, officers, managers, directors, or other persons acting in a similar capacity, or any other enterprise in which such persons held majority ownership. Id. DHS believes this information and documentation captures all the requirements identified by the RIA for a regional center's project application to be used as an investment offering for regional center investors. See, e.g., INA sec. 203(b)(5)(F)(i)(III) and (IV), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(i)(III) and (IV).
一旦区域中心证明其投资方案符合要求,并向美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)提供所有要求的文件,美国公民及移民服务局即会批准该申请。如获批准,与区域中心投资方案有关的项目申请要素,包括充分的就业创造和应投资的最低金额(如该投资方案属于目标就业地区项目或基础设施项目),将通过引用的方式纳入对区域中心投资人移民签证申请的审理中,前提是该区域中心投资人已提供其与该区域中心项目申请相关联的证据,这意味着区域中心投资人无需另行重复提交已随项目申请提交并经审查的同一项目层面的文件。见《移民与国籍法》(INA)第203(b)(5)(F)(ii)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(ii)。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.408(a)条。如果美国公民及移民服务局拒绝该项目申请,美国公民及移民服务局将提供说明决定理由的通知,并向区域中心提供有关其上诉权利的信息。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.422条。
Once a regional center establishes that its investment offering meets the requirements and provides all the required documentation to USCIS, USCIS would approve the application. If approved, the elements of the project application related to the regional center's investment offering, including sufficient job creation and minimum amount to be invested (where the investment offering is in a TEA or infrastructure project), will be incorporated by reference into the adjudication of the EB-5 immigrant visa petition of a regional center investor that has provided evidence of association with the regional center's project application, meaning the regional center investor will not separately have to submit the same project-level documentation already provided and reviewed with the project application. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(F)(ii), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(ii). See proposed 8 CFR 204.408(a). If USCIS denies the project application, then USCIS would provide a notice explaining the reasons for the decision and providing the regional center information on its right to appeal. See proposed 8 CFR 204.422.
a. 修改项目申请
a. Amending a Project Application
如获批准,在某些情况下,区域中心必须就其项目申请提交修正案。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(b)条和(c)条。国土安全部(DHS)建议要求区域中心在该特定投资方案中首位区域中心投资人有资格提交解除条件申请之前至少90天内,提交项目申请修正案。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(b)(1)条。作为该修正案申请的一部分,区域中心须提交以下更新文件:商业计划书、经济影响分析(EIA),以及用以确定该投资方案下区域中心投资人充分创造就业机会的合理且透明的方法。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(b)(2)条。此后,区域中心投资人即可依据该项目申请修正案的批准,证明其投资已创造足够的就业机会,从而根据拟议的8 CFR 216.6(e)(2)(ii)条确立其解除永久居留条件的资格。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(e)(4)条。如果区域中心未按要求提交项目申请修正案,美国公民及移民服务局将能够因其未能提交所需修正案而对该区域中心进行制裁。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(b)(7)(iii)条。
If approved, there are certain circumstances in which a regional center must submit an amendment to its project application. See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(b) and (c). DHS proposes requiring a regional center to submit an amendment to its project application within at least 90 days prior to the first regional center investor in that particular investment offering becoming eligible to file a petition to remove conditions. See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(b)(1). As part of that amendment filing, the regional center would have to submit the following updated documents: business plan, EIA, and reasonable and transparent methodologies to establish sufficient job creation for the regional center investors in that investment offering. See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(b)(2). A regional center investor would then be able to rely on the project application amendment's approval to establish that his or her investment created enough jobs to establish eligibility to remove the conditions on his or her residence under proposed 8 CFR 216.6(e)(2)(ii). See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(e)(4). If the regional center does not submit a project application amendment as required, USCIS would be able to sanction the regional center for failing to file a required amendment. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(b)(7)(iii).
此外,国土安全部建议,如发生可能影响已提交移民签证申请的区域中心投资人资格,以及可能基于项目申请中所列特定投资方案提交移民签证申请的区域中心投资人资格的变更,区域中心必须在该变更发生后30天内对其项目申请进行修正。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(c)条。如果区域中心因新商业企业或创造就业实体所有权或地址发生变更而须提交修正案,美国公民及移民服务局将暂缓审理所有相关联的EB-5移民签证申请,直至其完成对该修正案的审理,因为必须对变更性质进行审查,以确定该项目中区域中心投资人持续符合资格的情况。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(e)(2)条。其他需要进行修正的变更情形,则不一定要求美国公民及移民服务局暂缓审理相关联的EB-5移民签证申请,除非对该修正案的审查使美国公民及移民服务局认定其对相关联的EB-5移民签证申请存在负面影响。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(e)(3)条。
In addition, DHS proposes that a regional center must amend its project application within 30 days of the change where there may be an impact to the eligibility of any regional center investors that have already filed their EB-5 immigrant visa petition, as well as any regional center investors that may seek to file an EB-5 immigrant visa petition based on the particular investment offering identified in the project application. See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(c). Where the regional center would have to file an amendment due to a change in ownership or location of the new commercial enterprise or job-creating entity(ies), USCIS would hold adjudication of all associated EB-5 immigrant visa petitions until USCIS adjudicates the amendment because the nature of the change must be reviewed to determine the ongoing eligibility of regional center investors in the project. See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(e)(2). Other changes necessitating an amendment would not necessarily require USCIS to hold adjudication of the associated EB-5 immigrant visa petitions, unless review of the amendment would lead USCIS to determine that there is a negative impact on the associated EB-5 immigrant visa petitions. See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(e)(3).
DHS还提议,如果区域中心与先前批准的项目申请相关提交的任何商业计划中反映的资本支出或资本结构发生变化,从而对此类计划的可信度或可行性或项目的成功执行产生实质性影响或以其他方式产生影响,进而可能对相关投资者的资格产生不利影响(印刷页第40722页),区域中心必须提交修正案,包括但不限于向与商业计划相关的各方付款,以及丧失融资或增加来自先前批准的项目申请中未曾标明的来源的外部融资,或以其他方式从联邦监管的银行或其他金融机构(定义见18 U.S.C. 20)以外的任何来源获得融资。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(c)(5)。DHS旨在使此规定主要影响那些发生变化并影响已批准项目申请中所反映的就业岗位数量的区域中心。例如,当支出减少导致所创造的就业岗位数量减少时,将需要提交修正案,但对于现有商业贷款的增加(该增加可能创造投资者资格所不需要的额外就业岗位),则不需要提交修正案。还需要提交修正案以标明可能属于非传统或监管较少的新资金来源,例如来自先前无关联的个人或企业的新股权投资。
DHS also proposes that a regional center would have to file an amendment if there are changes to the expenditure of capital or capital structure reflected in any business plan submitted in connection with the previously approved project application in response to or otherwise materially impacting the credibility or viability of such plans or successful execution of projects that in turn could adversely ( printed page 40722) impact eligibility for associated investors, including, but not limited to, payments to parties related to the business plan and the loss of financing or addition of outside financing from sources not previously identified in the approved project application or otherwise obtained from any source other than a federally regulated bank or other financial institution (as defined in 18 U.S.C. 20). See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(c)(5). DHS intends that this would primarily affect regional centers making a change that impacts the number of jobs reflected in the approved project application. For example, an amendment would be required when there is a reduction in expenditures that decreases the number of jobs created, but would not be required for an increase of an existing commercial loan that may create additional jobs that are unnecessary for investor eligibility. An amendment would also be required to identify new sources of funding that may be non-traditional or less regulated, such as a new equity investment from a previously unaffiliated individual or business.
一旦获得批准,高失业率地区认定自项目申请提交之日起最初有效期为两年。移民与国籍法(INA)第203(b)(5)(B)(ii)(IV)(aa)(AA)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(B)(ii)(IV)(aa)(AA)。正如本序言第IV.E节所述,一旦美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)批准高失业率地区认定,USCIS将把最初的认定延长至批准通知书发出之日起两年。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.402(e)(1)。除了在正常业务过程中发生的某些变化外,DHS提议,如果区域中心在高失业率地区的最初认定本应到期之后仍继续为该项目寻求投资者,则区域中心必须修订其项目申请以寻求延长高失业率地区认定。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(c)(6)。DHS预计,某些项目的持续时间将远超区域中心提交项目申请之日起两年,并超出将高失业率地区认定从该日起延长两年的项目批准期限,因此需要延长高失业率地区认定。对于在最初高失业率地区认定期限(经项目批准延长后)之后寻求新投资者的项目,DHS还预计项目申请可能会有额外变化,区域中心应将其提交USCIS审查。因此,DHS提议区域中心可以通过向其项目申请提交修正案来寻求延长高失业率认定,以证明该地区仍然符合高失业率地区的要求。重要的是,如果区域中心投资者在高失业率地区认定到期之前已向新商业企业提供了随后提供给创造就业实体的全部资本,即使该地区不再符合高失业率地区的资格,也无需再进行任何额外投资。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.402(g)。但是,如果区域中心投资者在最初高失业率认定本应到期之前,尚未向新商业企业提供随后提供给创造就业实体的全部资本,则如果该地区不再符合高失业率地区的资格,可能需要增加其投资额。同上。
Once approved, a high unemployment area designation is initially valid for two years from the date on which the project application is filed. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(B)(ii)(IV)(aa)(AA), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(B)(ii)(IV)(aa)(AA). As discussed in section IV.E of this preamble, once USCIS approves the high unemployment area designation, USCIS would extend the initial designation for 2 years from the date of the approval notice. See proposed 8 CFR 204.402(e)(1). In addition to certain changes that take place in the due course of business, DHS proposes that a regional center would have to amend its project application to seek an extension of a high unemployment area designation if the regional center continues to seek investors in the project after the initial designation of a high unemployment area is otherwise due to expire. See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(c)(6). DHS expects that certain projects will extend well beyond 2 years from the date the regional center submits its project application and beyond the project approval which extends the high unemployment area designation two years from that date, necessitating an extension of the high unemployment area designation. For projects that seek new investors after the initial high unemployment area designation period (as extended by the project approval), DHS would also expect that there may be additional changes to the project application that a regional center should submit for USCIS review. Consequently, DHS proposes that a regional center may seek to extend a high unemployment designation by submitting an amendment to its project application to establish the area continues to meet the requirements of a high unemployment area. Importantly, regional center investors that provided the full amount of capital to the new commercial enterprise that was subsequently provided to the job-creating entity before the high unemployment area designation expires do not have to make any additional investments if the area no longer qualifies as a high unemployment area. See proposed 8 CFR 204.402(g). However, if the regional center investor did not provide the full amount of capital to the new commercial enterprise that was subsequently provided to the job-creating entity before the initial high unemployment designation will otherwise expire may be required to increase his or her investment if the area no longer qualifies as a high unemployment area. Id.
为了遏制并非出于善意提交的空洞、假设性或其他不合格的申请(例如,仅为满足适用截止日期而提交的修正申请,或纯属假设、无意实际开展相关项目而仅为允许提交相关投资者申请而提交的初始申请),对项目申请(包括初始申请)的任何修正均必须出于善意提交。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(d)条。在确定项目申请或修正是否出于善意提交时,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将审查申请人开展该项目的主观意图,以及申请人在客观上是否具有开展该项目的现实可能性。参见1994年1月10日第59 FR 1318号联邦公报。提交修正申请的区域中心还必须将此变更通知任何已就该特定投资方案提交移民签证申请的投资者。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.423(a)条。
In order to discourage skeletal, hypothetical or otherwise ineligible filings that are not filed in good faith (for example, amendments filed solely to meet applicable deadlines or initial applications that are purely hypothetical with no intention to undertake the actual project filed solely to permit the filing of associated investor petitions), any amendment to a project application (including the initial filing) must be submitted in good faith. See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(d). In determining whether a project application or amendment was submitted in good faith, USCIS would examine both the subjective intent of the applicant to undertake the project and whether objectively the applicant had a realistic prospect of undertaking the project. See59 FR 1318 (Jan. 10, 1994). A regional center that files an amendment must also notify any investors who have filed an immigrant visa petition associated with the particular investment offering of the change. See proposed 8 CFR 204.423(a).
b. 区域中心投资者
b. Regional Center Investors
根据拟议规则,一旦经指定的区域中心提交了项目申请,投资于该特定方案的区域中心投资者即可提交其I-526E表格。为被视为正式提交,区域中心投资者须在提交I-526E表格时一并提交其与区域中心待决或已批准的项目申请存在关联的证据。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.404(b)条。此类证据可包括向区域中心签发的I-956F表格收据通知副本,或区域中心已向USCIS提交I-956F表格的证据。为进一步证明其资格,区域中心投资者还须提交足够的文件,以证明其已投资所需数额的资本,且用于投资的资本来源合法。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.408(b)和(c)条。此前,即使区域中心在申请初始指定或修正时随I-924表格一并提交了I-526表格范例,每位区域中心投资者仍须单独提交项目文件,而根据新规,USCIS将在裁决I-956F项目申请时一并审查这些文件。区域中心投资者须在其I-526E表格上签署声明,确认其受项目申请所含各项协议的约束,该声明以引用方式将区域中心提供的全部项目文件纳入申请人的I-526E表格,但区域中心投资者原则上无需另行提交用以证明其资格相关要素的、支持项目申请的文件。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.404(b)条。
Under the proposed rule, once a designated regional center has filed a project application, a regional center investor investing in that particular offering would be able to submit his or her Form I-526E. To be considered properly filed, a regional center investor would have to submit evidence of association with a regional center's pending or approved project application with his or her Form I-526E. See proposed 8 CFR 204.404(b). Such evidence could include a copy of the Form I-956F receipt notice issued to the regional center or evidence the regional center submitted Form I-956F to USCIS. To otherwise establish his or her eligibility, a regional center investor would also have to submit sufficient documentation to establish that he or she has invested the required amount of capital, and that the capital used for the investment is lawful. See proposed 8 CFR 204.408(b) and (c). Whereas each individual regional center investor previously had to submit project documentation, even where the regional center submitted an exemplar Form I-526 with a Form I-924 application for initial designation or amendment, USCIS would now review those documents as part of the Form I-956F project application adjudication. The regional center investor would have to attest to being subject to those agreements included with the project application by signing a statement on the Form I-526E that incorporates all the project documentation provided by the regional center by reference into the petitioner's Form I-526E, but would not otherwise be expected to provide the documentation submitted in support of the project application that establishes those elements of the regional center investor's eligibility. See proposed 8 CFR 204.404(b).
c. 撤销项目申请批准
c. Revocation of Project Application Approval
美国国土安全部(DHS)提议,USCIS在特定情形下有权撤销项目申请的批准,包括对已批准项目申请的修正申请被拒绝、区域中心未能就已批准的项目申请提交所需的修正申请、发现区域中心未披露的任何影响项目资格的证据,或在裁决项目申请过程中存在重大法律或事实错误。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.424(a)条。USCIS将就上述任一既定理由发出拟撤销批准的通知。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.424(b)条。在撤销项目申请批准的通知发出后30日内,区域中心可根据本章第103部分的规定向行政上诉办公室提出上诉。在撤销决定最终确定之前,USCIS将暂缓裁决任何相关的EB-5移民签证申请。若项目申请的批准被撤销,USCIS将以其认为适当的方式和途径通知相关投资者。同上。DHS认为,这些规定是必要的,以便使USCIS能够纠正(印刷页第40723页)错误,或在区域中心未能持续向USCIS通报其项目持续资格状况时追究其责任。
DHS proposes that USCIS would have certain reasons to revoke the approval of a project application, including the denial of an amendment to an approved project application, the regional center's failure to submit a required amendment to an approved project application, the discovery of any evidence affecting program eligibility not disclosed by the regional center, or a material mistake of law or fact in the adjudication of the project application. See proposed 8 CFR 204.424(a). USCIS would provide a notice of its intent to revoke the approval for any of these stated reasons. See proposed 8 CFR 204.424(b). Within 30 days of the issuance of a notice of the revocation of the approval of a project application, a regional center may file an appeal with the Administrative Appeals Office under part 103 of this chapter. USCIS would hold the adjudication of any associated EB-5 immigrant visa petitions until the revocation decision is finalized and, if the approval of the project application is revoked, USCIS will notify associated investors as and in a manner USCIS determines to be appropriate. Id. DHS believes these provisions are necessary to provide USCIS the ability to correct ( printed page 40723) an error or hold the regional center to account for not continuing to keep USCIS updated on its project's ongoing eligibility.
此外,根据本拟议规则,在区域中心终止参与区域中心计划后,一旦就该终止决定提出的任何上诉得到裁决,或者如果未提出上诉,则在上诉期限届满后,项目申请将自动被撤销。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.424(c)条。根据《移民与国籍法》(INA)第203(b)(5)(P)条,即8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(P)条的规定,自动撤销不得上诉,因为美国国土安全部(DHS)认为,此项决定并非独立于导致自动撤销的决定(即区域中心的终止)之外的另一项可单独上诉的决定。此前由已终止的区域中心提交的项目申请所涵盖的任何新商业企业,均可与另一个被指定的区域中心重新建立关联关系。同上。为与另一区域中心建立关联,新的区域中心须代表该新商业企业提交一份项目申请,表明其对该特定投资方案的赞助,以及其对该新商业企业进行监测和监督的计划。如果受影响的区域中心投资者所涉及的新商业企业与另一个被指定的区域中心建立关联,且投资者在终止通知发出后180天内对其EB-5移民签证申请提交修正,则该投资者将保留其资格。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.424(c)条和8 CFR 204.410(c)条。此外,区域中心投资者也可以在收到撤销通知后180天内,对参与区域中心计划的另一新商业企业进行新的投资。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.410(c)条。任何区域中心投资者,如其新商业企业未与另一个被指定的区域中心建立关联,或未采取其他行动进行新的投资,其EB-5移民签证申请将被拒绝;如该申请此前已获批准,则将被撤销,但如在撤销之前已依照适用要求创造了足够的就业机会,且投资者的资本已按规定投资至少2年,则该投资者尽管项目申请批准被撤销,仍可能继续具备资格。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.424(d)条。任何EB-5移民签证申请均不得依赖已撤销的项目申请来确立资格。同上。
Additionally, under this proposed rule, the termination of the regional center's participation in the Regional Center Program results in the automatic revocation of a project application upon the adjudication of any appeal of the termination or, if no appeal is filed, the expiration of the appellate period. See proposed 8 CFR 204.424(c). Automatic revocations would not be appealable under section 203(b)(5)(P) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(P), because DHS believes that it is not a distinct determination separate from the determination resulting in automatic revocation (termination of the regional center), which would be separately appealable. Any new commercial enterprise previously covered by a project application submitted by a regional center that has since been terminated may be able to reassociate itself with another designated regional center. Id. To associate with another regional center, the new regional center would have to submit a project application on behalf of the new commercial enterprise, indicating its sponsorship of that particular investment offering and its plan to conduct monitoring and oversight of the new commercial enterprise. Affected regional center investors would retain their eligibility if the new commercial enterprise associates with another designated regional center and they file an amendment to their EB-5 immigrant visa petition within 180 days of notice of the termination. See proposed 8 CFR 204.424(c) and 8 CFR 204.410(c). Alternatively, the regional center investor would also be able to make a new investment in another new commercial enterprise participating in the Regional Center Program within 180 days of notification of the revocation. See proposed 8 CFR 204.410(c). Any regional center investor whose new commercial enterprise does not associate with another designated regional center or otherwise takes no action to make another investment would have his or her EB-5 immigrant visa petition denied, or revoked if the petition was previously approved, except that the investor may continue to be eligible notwithstanding the revocation of the project application approval where sufficient jobs were already created and the investor's capital was invested for at least 2 years under applicable requirements before the revocation. See proposed 8 CFR 204.424(d). No EB-5 immigrant visa petition may rely on a revoked project application to establish eligibility. Id.
丁. 项目申请批准的拒绝
d. Denial of Project Application Approval
美国国土安全部(DHS)建议,如项目申请未能依照拟议的8 CFR 204.420条确立资格,或未包含拟议的8 CFR 204.421条所要求的证据,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)可拒绝该项目申请。USCIS将以书面形式通知区域中心该拒绝决定,并依照8 CFR 103.3(a)(1)(i)条的规定说明拒绝理由。区域中心可依照8 CFR 103.3条的规定,就该拒绝决定向行政上诉办公室提出上诉。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.422(a)条。在该拒绝决定最终确定之前,USCIS将暂缓对任何相关EB-5移民签证申请的审理。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.422(b)条。根据拟议规定,一旦拒绝决定最终确定,区域中心投资者将无法依赖该被拒绝的项目申请来证明其资格,且任何与该被拒绝项目申请相关联的未决签证申请均将被拒绝。同上。
DHS proposes that USCIS may deny any project application that does not establish eligibility under proposed 8 CFR 204.420 or does not include the evidence required under proposed 8 CFR 204.421. USCIS would notify the regional center in writing of the denial decision and specify the reasons for the denial in compliance with 8 CFR 103.3(a)(1)(i). The regional center may appeal the denial to the Administrative Appeals Office according to 8 CFR 103.3. See proposed 8 CFR 204.422(a). USCIS would hold the adjudication of any associated EB-5 immigrant visa petitions until the denial decision is finalized. See proposed 8 CFR 204.422(b). As proposed, once the denial decision is finalized, a regional center investor will not be able to rely on the denied project application to demonstrate eligibility and any pending visa petitions associated with the denied project application will be denied. Id.
5. 资金重新部署
5. Redeployment
现行法规并未针对新商业企业在投资者须将投资资本持续置于风险之中的期限届满之前,完成其项目并退还投资者资本这一情形作出规定。美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)此前通过《USCIS政策手册》处理了在此类情况下投资者保持资格所需满足的要求。参见《USCIS政策手册》第6卷,G部分,第2章,A(2)节,“投资”,(2021年7月22日历史版本)。[91]
Current regulations do not address the situation of a new commercial enterprise completing its project and returning the investor's capital before the end of the period during which the investor is required to maintain the investment at risk. USCIS previously addressed the requirements for the investor to maintain eligibility in these circumstances through the USCIS Policy Manual. See USCIS Policy Manual, Volume 6, Part G, Chapter 2.A(2), “Investment,” (July 22, 2021, historical version).[91]
《改革与诚信法案》(RIA)明确指示USCIS制定法规,以实施关于新商业企业对投资者资本进行重新部署的若干法定参数要求。《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(F)(v)条,即8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(v)条。该等参数规定,在以下情况下,新商业企业将被允许在美国境内或其领土内的任何地点重新部署投资资金,以维持投资者资本处于风险之中:
The RIA specifically directs USCIS to prescribe regulations to implement certain statutory parameters for redeployment of investor capital by the new commercial enterprise. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(F)(v), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(v). Those parameters state that the new commercial enterprise will be allowed to redeploy investment funds anywhere within the United States or its territories for the purpose of maintaining the investors' capital at risk if:
1. 新商业企业已出于善意执行了该资本投资项目的商业计划,且未作出重大变更;
1. The new commercial enterprise has executed the business plan for a capital investment project in good faith without a material change;
2. 新商业企业已创建了足够数量的新全职职位,以满足该新商业企业所有投资者的项目就业创造要求;
2. The new commercial enterprise has created a sufficient number of new full-time positions to satisfy the job creation requirements of the program for all investors in the new commercial enterprise;
3. 创造就业机会的实体已按照商业计划所设想的初始投资方式偿还了最初投入的资本;且
3. The job-creating entity has repaid the capital initially deployed in conformity with the initial investment contemplated by the business plan; and
4. 创造就业机会的实体偿还资本后,该资本仍处于风险之中,且未被重新投入于诸如股票或债券等被动投资。移民与国籍法(INA)第203(b)(5)(F)(v)条,《美国法典》第8编第1153(b)(5)(F)(v)条。另见拟议的8 CFR 204.426(a)条。
4. The capital, after repayment by the job-creating entity, remains at risk and it is not redeployed in passive investments, such as stocks or bonds. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(F)(v), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(v). See also proposed 8 CFR 204.426(a).
若区域中心所属任一新商业企业违反了有关投资者资金再投放的任何法定要求,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)必须终止该区域中心的资格。移民与国籍法第203(b)(5)(F)(v)条,《美国法典》第8编第1153(b)(5)(F)(v)条。另见拟议的8 CFR 204.426(c)条。
USCIS must terminate a regional center if one of its associated new commercial enterprises violates any of the statutory requirements regarding the redeployment of investor funds. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(F)(v), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(v). See also proposed 8 CFR 204.426(c).
美国国土安全部(DHS)拟在本规则中对新商业企业再投放投资者资本的这些法定参数予以实施。见拟议的8 CFR 204.426条。国土安全部拟明确,善意执行资本投资项目商业计划包括妥善提交并获得修正案批准,且创造就业机会的实体偿还初始投资的方式同样可以通过妥善提交并获批准的修正案而不同于商业计划所设想的方式进行变更。见拟议的8 CFR 204.426(a)条。国土安全部进一步拟规定,投资者资本的任何再投放必须在资本返还给新商业企业之日起3个月内完成,但美国公民及移民服务局将根据具体情况的整体考量,考虑证明某一特定类型商业企业或特定商业活动所需更长期限属合理的证据。见拟议的8 CFR 204.426(b)条。国土安全部认为,这一时间段为新商业企业识别并执行投资者资本再投放投资提供了充分的灵活性,同时维持了该法规所要求投资须至少持续两年处于风险之中的立法意图。就法定禁止被动投资(如股票和债券)的限制而言,国土安全部拟将该法定禁止规定成文化,并使其与现行做法保持一致,以明确该规定适用于所有二级市场证券,以及与任何商业活动使用无关的一级市场证券(即购买证券(印刷版第40724页)主要属于金融性质而非商业性质的情形)。
DHS proposes to implement these statutory parameters for redeployment of investor capital by the new commercial enterprise in this rule. See proposed 8 CFR 204.426. DHS proposes to clarify that the execution of the business plan for a capital investment project in good faith includes properly filing and receiving approval for amendments, and that repayment of the initial investment by the job-creating entity can likewise be changed from that contemplated by the business plan by a properly filed and approved amendment. See proposed 8 CFR 204.426(a). DHS further proposes that any redeployment of investor capital must be made within 3 months of the return of the capital to the new commercial enterprise, except that USCIS will consider evidence showing that a longer period was reasonable for a specific type of commercial enterprise or into a specific commercial activity under the totality of the circumstances. See proposed 8 CFR 204.426(b). DHS believes that this period of time provides sufficient flexibility for a new commercial enterprise to identify and execute an investment for the redeployment of investor capital while maintaining the intent of the statute that the investment remains at risk for at least two years. For purposes of the statutory restriction on passive investments, such as stocks and bonds, DHS proposes to codify the statutory prohibition, and align it with existing practice to clarify that this applies to all secondary market securities and to primary market securities that are unrelated to use in any commercial activity ( i.e., where the purchase of ( printed page 40724) securities is primarily financial rather than commercial in nature).
若新商业企业未能遵守8 CFR 204.426条所规定的再投放参数,美国公民及移民服务局将终止该区域中心的designation(指定资格),并可根据拟议的8 CFR 204.431条,将该新商业企业从区域中心计划中予以debar(除名)或施以其他制裁。见拟议的8 CFR 204.426(c)条。
USCIS will terminate a regional center's designation and may debar or otherwise sanction the new commercial enterprise from participation in the Regional Center Program under proposed 8 CFR 204.431 if the new commercial enterprise does not comply with the parameters of redeployment provided in 8 CFR 204.426. See proposed 8 CFR 204.426(c).
6. 直接推介人与第三方推介人
6. Direct and Third-Party Promoters
移民与国籍法要求,与特定资本投资项目相关、拟向移民投资者发行证券的区域中心、新商业企业、关联的创造就业机会的实体或证券发行人的任何直接或第三方推介人,须向美国公民及移民服务局登记其作为推介人的参与情况。移民与国籍法第203(b)(5)(K)条,《美国法典》第8编第1153(b)(5)(K)条。本拟议规则将把登记要求和程序予以成文化。见拟议的8 CFR 204.428条。
The INA requires any direct or third-party promoter of a regional center, new commercial enterprise, affiliated job-creating entity, or issuer of securities intended to be offered to immigrant investors in connection with a particular capital investment project to register his or her participation as a promoter with USCIS. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(K), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(K). This proposed rule would codify the registration requirements and process. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428.
登记程序
Registration Process
每位推介人必须就其在区域中心计划中的参与情况向美国公民及移民服务局进行登记。移民与国籍法第203(b)(5)(K)条,《美国法典》第8编第1153(b)(5)(K)条;另见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(a)条。若推介人为一实体,则该实体中所有以符合拟议8 CFR 204.401条所述推介人定义的身份工作的人员,也必须向美国公民及移民服务局提交I-956K表格。反之,若某一必须向美国公民及移民服务局登记的组织的雇员并未实际参与某一特定投资项目的推介工作,则无需提交I-956K表格。例如,该组织的行政管理人员即属此种情形。
Every promoter must register his or her participation in the Regional Center Program with USCIS. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(K), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(K); see also proposed 8 CFR 204.428(a). If the promoter is an entity, then all promoters working for that entity in a role that meets the definition of promoter described in proposed 8 CFR 204.401 would also have to submit Form I-956K to USCIS. Conversely, employees of an organization required to register with USCIS who are not involved in the actual promotion of a particular investment offering would not be required to submit Form I-956K. This would include, for example, administrative staff of the organization.
美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)发布了I-956K表,《直接和第三方推介人注册表》,以便参与区域中心计划的推介人向USCIS提供所有必要信息。与当前做法类似,根据拟议规则,推介人在提交其表格时须包含身份识别信息,包括在适用情况下提供生物特征信息,以便USCIS适当确认登记人的身份;须提供其根据《移民与国籍法》(INA)第203(b)(5)(H)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(H)款,有资格参与区域中心计划的证明;须证明其熟悉注册的规则和标准;并须确认推介人与之订立协议的每个实体均存在书面协议,并在其注册表中附上该书面协议的副本。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(b)。如果推介人是一个组织,且该组织的所有员工均被I-956K表所附书面协议涵盖,则只要该组织已就该等书面协议向USCIS提供了副本,这些员工无需提交相同书面协议的副本。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(f)。此外,每位推介人必须向其为特定投资要约寻求投资的任何区域中心投资者提供相关书面协议的副本。该书面协议须充分披露推介人就区域中心计划下某一要约的投资已经收到或将收到的任何费用、持续利息和其他报酬。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(d)(1)。区域中心投资者必须在其I-526E表上证明其已收到该书面协议的副本。
USCIS published Form I-956K, Registration for Direct and Third-Party Promoters, to allow promoters participating in the Regional Center Program to provide all the necessary information to USCIS. Similar to current practice, under the proposed rule, with his or her form, a promoter would have to include identifying information, including providing biometrics, if applicable, for USCIS to properly confirm the identity of the registrant, provide certifications that he or she is eligible to participate in the Regional Center Program under section 203(b)(5)(H) of INA, 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(H); certify his or her familiarity with the rules and standards for registration; and confirm the existence of a written agreement for each entity with which the promoter has entered into agreement and include a copy of the written agreement(s) with his or her registration. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(b). If the promoter is an organization and all employees of that organization are covered by the written agreements provided with the Form I-956K, those employees would not have to submit a copy of the same written agreements, provided the organization already provided a copy of any such written agreements to USCIS with its Form I-956K. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(f). Further, each promoter must provide a copy of the relevant written agreement to any regional center investors it seeks for investment in the particular investment offering. The written agreement would have to provide a full disclosure of any fees, ongoing interest, and other compensation that have been, or will be, received by a promoter in connection with an investment in an offering under the Regional Center Program. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(d)(1). Regional center investors must certify on their Form I-526E that they received a copy of the written agreement.
每位推介人还须在其I-956K表上证明,其熟悉并将向潜在投资者准确介绍区域中心计划和美国移民签证流程。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(c)。美国国土安全部(DHS)曾考虑要求推介人完成一项测试要求,以证明其充分理解区域中心计划和美国移民签证流程。然而,DHS认为,实施此类要求对于推介人注册程序的妥善管理而言并不可行。因此,DHS拟要求推介人自行证明其知识水平,并利用其在INA项下的权力,在推介人未向移民投资者提供准确信息时暂停或禁止其参与区域中心计划。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(c)和(g)。该证明要求将包括根据推介人基于USCIS和美国国务院(State)公开信息所掌握的最佳知识,向投资者提供有关获得移民签证或永久居民身份所涉步骤的准确信息,包括该流程可能耗费的时间长度。92 参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(c)。
Each promoter would also have to certify on his or her Form I-956K that he or she is familiar with and will accurately represent the Regional Center Program and the U.S. immigrant visa process to prospective investors. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(c). DHS considered requiring promoters to complete a testing requirement to establish that they sufficiently understand the Regional Center Program and the U.S. immigrant visa process. However, DHS believes the administration of any such requirement would not be practical for the proper administration of the promoter registration process. Rather, DHS is proposing to require the promoter to certify his or her own knowledge and to utilize its authority under the INA to suspend or bar a promoter from participating in the Regional Center Program if he or she is not providing accurate information to immigrant investors. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(c) and (g). The certification requirement would include providing investors with accurate information about the steps involved in obtaining an immigrant visa or permanent resident status, including the length of time the process may take, to the best of the promoter's knowledge based on information made publicly available by USCIS and State. 92 See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(c).
此外,推介人不得在任何推广材料中使用操纵性、欺骗性或欺诈性的声明,此类声明可能包括虚假或具有重大误导性的陈述、未能讨论使该要约具有投机性或风险性的任何重大因素、提供财务或移民成功的预测,或声称USCIS或任何美国政府机构已审查或批准了某要约的计算结果或业绩表现。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(e)(1)。在区域中心已收到USCIS批准通知的情况下,推介人或其推广材料可以笼统地声明该区域中心提交的项目申请已获批准。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(e)(1)(v)。根据本拟议规则,确保所使用的任何推广材料不含任何操纵性、欺骗性或欺诈性声明,并符合所有适用的移民法和证券法,将是推介人的责任。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(e)(3)。此外,推介人须保留所有推广材料,并在USCIS要求时提供,必要时须附带译文。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(e)(4)。推介人还必须遵守所有适用的联邦和州证券法。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(e)(5)。
Additionally, the promoter would not be able to use manipulative, deceptive, or fraudulent claims in any promotional materials, which could include false or materially misleading statements, failing to discuss any material factors that make the offering speculative or risky, providing predictions of financial or immigration success, or stating that USCIS or any U.S. Government agency has reviewed or approved an offering's calculations or performance results. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(e)(1). A promoter, or his or her promotional materials, would be able to state generally that a project application submitted by the regional center is approved, where the regional center has received an approval notice from USCIS. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(e)(1)(v). Under this proposed rule, it would be the promoter's responsibility to ensure that any promotional materials used do not contain any manipulative, deceptive, or fraudulent claims and comply with all applicable immigration and securities laws. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(e)(3). In addition, the promoter would have to retain all promotional materials, and provide them to USCIS upon request, including a translation when necessary. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(e)(4). And the promoter must comply with all applicable Federal and State securities laws. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(e)(5).
当推介人提交I-956K表格后,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将向推介人签发收据通知,表明该推介人已正确提交I-956K表格。在完成某些背景调查以核实是否符合项目要求后,USCIS随后将向推介人签发注册通知。另外,若USCIS认定I-956K表格不符合项目要求(例如未确认书面协议),USCIS通常会先签发未注册通知,并给予推介人回应机会,然后再签发最终未注册通知。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(a)。
When a promoter files Form I-956K, USCIS would issue a receipt notice to the promoter indicating the promoter properly filed Form I-956K. After performing certain background checks to verify compliance with program requirements, USCIS would then issue the promoter a notice of registration. Alternatively, if USCIS finds that the Form I-956K does not meet program requirements (such as by not acknowledging a written agreement), USCIS would generally first issue a notice of non-registration and provide the promoter an opportunity to respond before issuing a final notice of non-registration. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(a).
（印刷页第40725页）
( printed page 40725)
根据本拟议规则,USCIS通常会接受I-956K表格,除非该推介人已被暂停或永久禁止[93]参与区域中心项目,或该表格不符合其他提交要求,例如缺少推介人的姓名和/或联系信息,或缺少或未签署的证明。因此,推介人一旦提交I-956K表格,即可开始在区域中心项目下进行推介活动。同上。但是,如果推介人收到最终未注册通知,则该推介人必须停止任何EB-5项目的推介活动。推介人一旦完成注册程序,该注册将持续有效,直至该推介人寻求撤回其注册,或USCIS暂停或禁止该推介人参与区域中心项目为止。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(g);另见8 CFR 204.431(b)(10)。国土安全部(DHS)提出了USCIS可能寻求暂停或禁止推介人的理由,包括未能遵守适用于推介人的规则和标准,以及违反任何适用的联邦和州证券法。同上。如果USCIS确定应暂停或禁止某推介人参与区域中心项目,USCIS将向该推介人发送说明暂停或禁止理由的通知。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(g)、8 CFR 204.431(b)(10)、(e)和(h)。该推介人通常有机会对所提供的理由提出反驳。同上。暂停并不必然排除推介人未来参与区域中心项目的可能性。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)(3)(iv)。但是,如果USCIS永久禁止某推介人参与,则该推介人将无法再次参与区域中心项目。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)(5)(i)。
Under this proposed rule, USCIS would generally accept the Form I-956K, except where the promoter is suspended or permanently barred [93] from participation in the Regional Center Program or the form otherwise does not meet filing requirements, such as missing name and/or contact information of the promoter or missing or unsigned certifications. As such, a promoter can begin promoting under the Regional Center Program once he or she submits Form I-956K. Id. However, if a promoter receives a final notice of non-registration, then that promoter must cease any promotion activities of the EB-5 program. Once a promoter completes the registration process, the registration would remain in place until such time as the promoter seeks to withdraw his or her registration or USCIS suspends or bars the promoter from participating in the Regional Center Program. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(g); see also8 CFR 204.431(b)(10). DHS proposes reasons that USCIS may seek to suspend or bar a promoter, including any failure to follow the rules and standards for promoters and violations of any applicable Federal and State securities laws. Id. If USCIS determines a promoter should be suspended or barred from participation in the Regional Center Program, USCIS would send a notice to the promoter explaining the reasons for the suspension or bar. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(g), 8 CFR 204.431(b)(10), (e) and (h). The promoter would generally have an opportunity to rebut the reasons provided. Id. A suspension would not necessarily preclude a promoter's future involvement in the Regional Center Program. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(3)(iv). However, if USCIS permanently bars a promoter's participation, the promoter would not be able to participate in the Regional Center Program again. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(5)(i).
推介人的暂停或禁止参与也可能影响使用该推介人的区域中心、新商业企业或关联创造就业实体,如果这些实体中的任何一个在明知某推介人不符合成为推介人的要求的情况下仍与其建立关联,或在获悉该推介人被暂停或禁止后14天内未采取任何行动停止使用该被暂停或禁止的推介人。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.428(g)(3)。如果USCIS暂停或禁止某推介人参与区域中心项目,且USCIS能够从其记录中确定使用过该推介人的实体,USCIS可向受影响的实体通报该推介人被暂停或禁止的情况。同上。
A promoter's suspension or debarment may also impact the regional center, new commercial enterprise, or affiliated job-creating entity that utilized the promoter, if any of those entities knowingly associated with a promoter that does not meet the requirements to be a promoter or does not take any action to discontinue use of a suspended or barred promoter within 14 days of learning of the suspension or bar. See proposed 8 CFR 204.428(g)(3). If USCIS suspends or bars a promoter from participation in the Regional Center Program and USCIS can determine from its records those entities that used that promoter, USCIS may notify the affected entities of the promoter's suspension or bar. Id.
国土安全部欢迎公众就直接推介人和第三方推介人的注册程序提出意见。国土安全部还欢迎就注册、暂停推介人和禁止推介人可能考虑的标准提出意见,包括对这些标准的替代性建议。
DHS welcomes public comment on the registration process for direct and third-party promoters. DHS also welcomes comment on the standards that may be considered for registration, suspension of a promoter and debarment of a promoter, including alternative suggestions to those standards.
7. 资金管理人
7. Fund Administrators
《移民与国籍法》要求每个新商业企业及其关联的创造就业实体,将从移民投资者处获得的资金保存在单独账户中,该账户仅可用于接收和投入资本投资项目使用的资本,或将资本退还给提供该资本的移民投资者。《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(Q)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)。新商业企业或关联的创造就业实体还必须聘用符合特定要求的基金管理人,以监督和跟踪EB-5投资者资本向及从该单独账户的任何转移。《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(Q)(iv)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(iv)。如果新商业企业或关联的创造就业实体受在美国证券交易委员会注册的投资顾问或经纪交易商控制,或与该投资顾问或经纪交易商受共同控制,且美国国土安全部(DHS)酌情认定证券交易委员会为移民投资者提供的保护和透明度与《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(Q)(iv)条所要求的相当,则美国国土安全部可豁免该要求。《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(Q)(v)(I)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(v)(I)。此外,对于委托对该新商业企业或创造就业实体进行年度独立财务审计,并将该审计报告提交美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)以及该新商业企业的所有投资者的任何新商业企业或关联的创造就业实体,美国国土安全部必须豁免该要求。《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(Q)(v)(II)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(v)(II)。美国国土安全部提议将这些规定纳入法规。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.425条。
The INA requires each new commercial enterprise and affiliated job-creating entity to keep funds received from immigrant investors in a separate account that may only be used to receive and deploy capital for use in the capital investment project or to return capital to an immigrant investor that provided it. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(Q), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q). The new commercial enterprise or affiliated job-creating entity must also use a fund administrator that meets certain requirements to oversee and track any transfer of EB-5 investor capital to and from the separate account. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(Q)(iv), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(iv). DHS may waive this requirement if the new commercial enterprise or affiliated job-creating entity is controlled by or under common control of an investment adviser or broker-dealer that is registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission if, in DHS's discretion, the SEC provides comparable protections and transparency for immigrant investors as that required by section 203(b)(5)(Q)(iv) of the INA. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(Q)(v)(I), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(v)(I). Further, DHS must waive the requirement for any new commercial enterprise or affiliated job-creating entity that commissions an annual independent financial audit of such new commercial enterprise or job-creating entity and provides the audit to USCIS, as well as all investors in the new commercial enterprise. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(Q)(v)(II), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(v)(II). DHS proposes to incorporate these provisions into the regulations. See proposed 8 CFR 204.425.
关于根据《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(Q)(v)(II)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(v)(II)对基金管理人要求的强制豁免,美国国土安全部提议明确,年度独立审计必须涵盖该新商业企业以及该新商业企业已向其支付从区域中心投资者处获得的投资资金的任何创造就业实体。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.425(b)条。关于根据《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(Q)(v)(I)条可获得的酌情豁免,美国国土安全部提议,区域中心可在为寻求该豁免的新商业企业提交项目申请时请求该豁免,或通过对先前提交的项目申请提交修正案的方式,寻求对基金管理人要求的豁免。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.425(c)条。在任何一种情况下,基金管理人要求仅影响参与区域中心计划的新商业企业。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.425(a)条。
For the mandatory waiver of the fund administrator requirement under section 203(b)(5)(Q)(v)(II) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(v)(II), DHS proposes to clarify that the annual independent audit would have to cover the new commercial enterprise and any job-creating entity to which the new commercial enterprise has disbursed investment funds received from regional center investors. See proposed 8 CFR 204.425(b). For the discretionary waiver available under section 203(b)(5)(Q)(v)(I) of the INA, DHS proposes that a regional center may request such a waiver when it files the project application for the new commercial enterprise seeking such a waiver, or by submitting an amendment to a previous project application seeking a waiver of the fund administrator requirement. See proposed 8 CFR 204.425(c). In either case, the fund administrator requirement would only impact new commercial enterprises participating in the Regional Center Program. See proposed 8 CFR 204.425(a).
无论新商业企业是聘用基金管理人还是获得该要求的豁免,新商业企业使用区域中心投资者资本的方式均受特定限制。《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(Q)(ii)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(ii)。美国国土安全部提议在本规则中纳入这些资金支付要求。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.425(d)条。
Whether a new commercial enterprise employs a fund administrator or obtains a waiver of such requirement, the new commercial enterprise may only use regional center investor capital in certain manners. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(Q)(ii), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(Q)(ii). DHS proposes to capture these disbursement requirements in this rule. See proposed 8 CFR 204.425(d).
8. 执法:罚款、暂停、终止及除名
8. Enforcement: Monetary Penalties, Suspensions, Terminations, and Debarments
《移民与国籍法》(INA)的多项条款授权美国国土安全部(DHS)对指定的区域中心、其新商业企业、其创造就业机会的实体(无论是否存在关联关系)以及向区域中心投资者发行或拟发行证券的发行人实施制裁或采取其他行动。见INA第203(b)(5)(E)(vii)(III)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(E)(vii)(III)条;INA第203(b)(5)(F)(v)(II)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(v)(II)条;INA第203(b)(5)(G)(iii)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii)条;INA第203(b)(5)(H)(iv)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(H)(iv)条;INA第203(b)(5)(I)(iv)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(I)(iv)条;以及INA第203(b)(5)(J)(iv)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(J)(iv)条。其他条款则授权DHS暂停或禁止此类实体或参与区域中心项目的其他个人(例如此类实体的推介人)的参与资格。见INA第203(b)(5)(K)(ii)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(K)(ii)条;INA第203(b)(5)(N)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(N)条;以及INA第203(b)(5)(O)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(O)条。为便于查阅与适用,DHS提议将这些法定制裁条款整合至拟议的8 CFR 204.431条中。具体而言,DHS提议制定相关法规条款,对区域中心、新商业企业、创造就业机会的实体、向寻求根据INA第203(b)(5)条获得分类的投资者发行或拟发行证券的发行人,以及相关联方(包括所有者、推介人及参与此类实体的其他人员)因违规行为实施各种制裁(第40726页印刷版),包括暂停、终止和取消资格。见拟议的8 CFR 204.431条。DHS提议列出一份将导致实施制裁或其他授权行动的违规行为清单。见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(b)条。
Various provisions of the INA provide DHS the authority to sanction or take other actions against a designated regional center, its new commercial enterprises, its job-creating entities, affiliated or otherwise, and issuers of securities offered or intended to be offered to regional center investors. See INA sec. 203(b)(5)(E)(vii)(III), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(E)(vii)(III), INA sec. 203(b)(5)(F)(v)(II), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(v)(II), INA sec. 203(b)(5)(G)(iii), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii), INA sec. 203(b)(5)(H)(iv), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(H)(iv), INA sec. 203(b)(5)(I)(iv), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(I)(iv) and INA sec. 203(b)(5)(J)(iv), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(J)(iv). Other provisions provide DHS the authority to suspend or bar the participation of such entities or other individuals participating in the Regional Center Program, such as promoters of such entities. See INA sec. 203(b)(5)(K)(ii), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(K)(ii), INA sec. 203(b)(5)(N), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(N), and INA sec. 203(b)(5)(O), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(O). For ease of reference and application, DHS proposes to consolidate these statutory sanction provisions into proposed 8 CFR 204.431. Specifically, DHS proposes regulatory provisions providing for the imposition of various ( printed page 40726) sanctions, including suspensions, terminations, and debarments, against a regional center, new commercial enterprise, job-creating entity, issuer of securities offered or intended to be offered to investors seeking classification under section 203(b)(5) of the INA and associated parties, including owners, promoters and others involved with such entities for violations. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431. DHS proposes a list of violations that would warrant sanctions or other authorized actions. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(b).
INA指示DHS针对区域中心及某些相关联方,根据违规行为的严重程度建立一套分级制裁体系,其中包括罚款、暂停、取消资格和终止。INA第203(b)(5)(G)(iii)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii)条。因此,DHS提议根据违反INA的严重程度发布制裁,制裁可能包括:
The INA directs DHS to establish a graduated set of sanctions based on the severity of the violation for regional centers and certain associated parties that includes fines, suspension, debarment and termination. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(G)(iii), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii). Therefore, DHS proposes that sanctions would be issued based on the severity of the violations of the INA and could include:
1. 违规认定通知,将对违反法律或法规的行为予以通知,例如责令停止通知书,并将其纳入美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)相关的诉讼记录中;
1. A Finding of Violation Notice that will provide notification of a violation of law or regulation, such as a cease-and-desist letter, and be included in the relevant USCIS record of proceeding;
2. 罚款金额不超过移民投资者直接投资于涉及此类违规行为的区域中心新商业企业或创造就业机会实体的投资总额的10%;
2. Monetary penalties equal to not more than 10 percent of the total capital invested by immigrant investors in the regional center's new commercial enterprises or job-creating entities directly involved in such violations;
3. 暂停参与EB-5项目,暂停范围可为全部或部分;
3. Suspension from participation in the EB-5 program, which may be in whole or in part;
4. 终止区域中心的指定资格;
4. Termination of a regional center's designation;
5. 取消区域中心、新商业企业或创造就业机会实体参与EB-5项目的资格;以及
5. Debarment from participation in the EB-5 program for the regional center, new commercial enterprise, or job-creating entity; and
6. 取消与区域中心、新商业企业或创造就业机会实体相关联的一人或多人参与EB-5项目的资格。
6. Debarment from participation in the EB-5 program for one or more persons associated with the regional center, new commercial enterprise, or job-creating entity.
见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)条。
See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d).
根据拟议规则,USCIS可在发布制裁之前采取合理行动,以收集有关潜在或疑似违规行为的信息,采取补救措施,遏制未来违规行为,并确保持续遵守EB-5项目的要求。见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(e)条。例如,当USCIS获悉存在虚假陈述、不合格人员参与、证券监管机构即将采取行动,或未缴纳所需费用的证据时,可发出警告函,以避免或纠正合规问题。该函件还将说明若当事人或实体未能纠正违规行为时将提出的任何拟议制裁。
Under the proposed rule, USCIS may take reasonable actions to collect information regarding a potential or suspected violation, to pursue remedial action, to deter future violations, and to ensure ongoing compliance with the EB-5 program before issuing a sanction. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(e). For example, USCIS may issue warning letters when it becomes aware of evidence of false statements, the involvement of ineligible individuals, impending actions taken by securities regulators, or the failure to pay required fees to avert or correct compliance concerns. The letter would also include any proposed sanction if the person or entity does not remedy the violation.
美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)在认定或以其他方式认为区域中心、新商业企业、创造就业实体或推介人正在从事或已经从事违反拟议8 CFR 204.431(b)条中所列法律、规则或法规的行为,或从事其他被禁止的活动时,亦可发出违规通知或预先制裁通知,例如停止及终止函。参见拟议8 CFR 204.431(d)至(e)条。例如,这些通知或函件可用于告知区域中心或推介人停止从事拟议8 CFR 204.428条及拟议8 CFR 204.431(b)(10)条规则和标准所禁止的营销活动,或停止滥用国土安全部(DHS)或USCIS的印章。这些预先制裁通知,包括停止及终止函,通常还会包含在相关人员或实体未能纠正违规行为时可能施加的任何进一步拟议制裁。参见拟议8 CFR 204.231(e)条。
USCIS may also issue notices of violation or pre-sanction notices, such as cease and desist letters, when it finds or otherwise believes that a regional center, new commercial enterprise, job-creating entity, or promoter is engaging or has engaged in the violation of a law, rule, or regulation in proposed 8 CFR 204.431(b) or other prohibited activity. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)-(e). For example, these notices or letters could be used to inform regional centers or promoters to cease marketing activities prohibited by the rules and standards in proposed 8 CFR 204.428 and proposed 8 CFR 204.431(b)(10) or to cease the misuse of the DHS or USCIS seal. These pre-sanction notices, including cease-and-desist letters, would generally also include any further proposed sanction if the person or entity does not remedy the violation. See proposed 8 CFR 204.231(e).
无论USCIS发出的是警告函还是其他类型的通知,USCIS通常会首先发出一份通知,说明启动制裁程序的行为以及USCIS拟施加的制裁。参见拟议8 CFR 204.431(f)(2)条。每项制裁的作出均应基于对特定因素的考量,例如行为方式、性质、严重程度、过错程度及造成的损害,以确定应施加制裁的严重程度。参见拟议8 CFR 204.431(c)条。国土安全部指出,根据本拟议规则,USCIS可就任何一项违规行为施加一项以上的制裁。参见拟议8 CFR 204.431(d)条。例如,若USCIS认定某区域中心未能遵守其为监督和管理相关新商业企业而采纳的政策和程序,从而从事与其资格不符的行为,例如未能充分审查某人,或明知某人根据《移民与国籍法》(INA)第203(b)(5)(H)条,即8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(H)条规定,无资格参与区域中心计划,仍允许其参与该区域中心的某新商业企业,则USCIS可对该区域中心处以罚款。参见拟议8 CFR 204.431(d)(2)条。如果该区域中心未能确保其新商业企业采取商业上合理的措施将该人员从区域中心计划中予以清除,则USCIS可就该持续性违规行为对该区域中心及其相关新商业企业中的一方或双方施加额外制裁。此外,若该区域中心未缴纳罚款,则该不缴纳行为本身即构成另一项可予制裁的违法行为。参见拟议8 CFR 204.431(b)(9)条。
Regardless of whether USCIS sends a warning letter or other type of notice, USCIS would generally first issue a notice identifying the actions that initiated the sanctions process as well as the sanction USCIS is imposing. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(f)(2). Each sanction would be issued based on a consideration of certain factors, such as the manner, nature, magnitude, culpability, and harm, when determining the severity of a sanction to issue. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(c). DHS notes that under the proposed rule, USCIS would be able to issue more than one sanction for any violation. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d). For example, if USCIS determines that a regional center is engaging in conduct inconsistent with its designation by failing to adhere to its policies and procedures adopted to monitor and oversee associated new commercial enterprises, such as failing to adequately screen or knowingly permitting a person to be involved with one of its new commercial enterprises who is ineligible to participate in the Regional Center Program under section 203(b)(5)(H) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(H), USCIS could issue a monetary penalty to the regional center. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(2). If the regional center does not ensure that its new commercial enterprise takes commercially reasonable steps to remove the person from participating in the Regional Center Program, then USCIS would be able to issue additional sanctions for the ongoing violation to either or both the regional center and its associated new commercial enterprise. Additionally, if the regional center does not pay the monetary penalty, nonpayment would constitute an additional sanctionable offense. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(b)(9).
受影响方在收到制裁通知后,可采取行动以遵守该制裁通知,或就任何最终裁定向行政上诉办公室提出重新开庭或重新考虑动议或上诉。参见拟议8 CFR 204.431(g)及(h)条。如受影响方受到多项制裁,则对其寻求复核的每一项制裁,均必须及时分别提出动议或上诉。参见拟议8 CFR 204.231(f)(1)条。例如,若某受影响方同时受到罚款和暂停处分,且该受影响方希望行政上诉办公室对两项制裁均进行复核,则其须分别提出两份独立的上诉。此项要求有助于为根据《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(P)(ii)条,即8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(P)(ii)条规定的用尽行政救济之目的,明确界定受影响方已寻求行政上诉复核的具体制裁项目。此外,该要求也为USCIS提供了必要的灵活性,以高效监督EB-5项目的诚信性。
Upon receipt of a sanction notice, the affected party could take action to comply with the sanction notice or file a motion to reopen or reconsider or appeal any final determination to the Administrative Appeals Office. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(g) and (h). If an affected party is the subject of multiple sanctions, a separate motion or appeal must be timely filed for each sanction the affected party seeks to have reviewed. See proposed 8 CFR 204.231(f)(1). For example, if an affected party received both a fine and a suspension and the affected party wished to have both sanctions reviewed by the Administrative Appeals Office, then he or she would be required to file two separate appeals. This requirement serves to clearly identify the sanctions for which an affected party has sought administrative appellate review for exhaustion purposes under section 203(b)(5)(P)(ii) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(P)(ii). Furthermore, this requirement provides USCIS with the necessary flexibility to efficiently oversee the integrity of the EB-5 program.
甲、罚款
a. Monetary Penalties
根据拟议规则,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)可以根据区域中心对适用要求的特定违规行为,对其实施罚款处罚(即罚金)。参见,例如,移民与国籍法(INA)第203(b)(5)(G)(iii)(II)(aa)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii)(II)(aa)(“罚款额不得超过外国投资者在该区域中心新商业企业中所投入资本总额的10% ……”);参见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)(2)。为简化针对移民与国籍法第203(b)(5)(G)(iii)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii)下某些常见违规行为(例如未能提交年度报告)实施罚款的程序,国土安全部(DHS)考虑规定固定金额的罚款,而不是根据每项违规行为的严重程度逐案确定罚款金额,该罚款金额上限为EB-5投资者在涉及此类违规行为的区域中心新商业企业或直接参与此类违规行为的创造就业实体中所投入资本总额的10%(法定限额)。例如,按照该方式,对于其新商业企业或创造就业实体中有一名或多名投资者,但未能在规定截止日期前提交年度报告(其中应包含其每个新商业企业和创造就业实体(印刷版第40727页)所需信息)的区域中心,国土安全部将对其处以10,000美元的固定罚款。国土安全部正在就是否应针对某些常见违规行为规定固定罚款金额征求公众意见和反馈,尤其是此类罚款的金额以及可能涵盖的违规行为类型。
Under the proposed rule, USCIS could impose monetary penalties ( i.e., fines) on regional centers based on particular violations of applicable requirements. See, e.g., INA sec. 203(b)(5)(G)(iii)(II)(aa), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii)(II)(aa) (“fines equal to not more than 10 percent of the total capital invested by alien investors in the regional center's new commercial enterprises . . .”); see proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(2). To streamline the process for imposing monetary penalties for certain common violations under section 203(b)(5)(G)(iii) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii) (such as failure to file an annual statement), DHS considered prescribing set amounts for monetary penalties rather than making individualized determinations for the amount of the monetary penalty based on the severity of each violation up to the statutory limit of 10 percent of the total capital invested by EB-5 investors in the regional center's new commercial enterprises or job-creating entities directly involved in such violations. For example, under that approach, DHS would impose a set monetary penalty of $10,000 on a regional center with one or more investors in its new commercial enterprises or job-creating entities that does not file its annual statement (with required information for each of its new commercial enterprises and job-creating ( printed page 40727) entities) by the required due date. DHS is seeking public input and feedback on whether to prescribe set monetary penalties for certain common violations, particularly the amount for such penalties and the types of violations that may be covered.
二、暂停
b. Suspensions
根据拟议规则,USCIS可以暂停任何人参与EB-5项目的资格。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)(3)。国土安全部拟议规定,暂停是指临时禁止被暂停人员参与EB-5项目的部分或全部形式。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.401,“暂停”定义。暂停可以是以时间或违规行为为限的制裁措施,以通常具有建设性的方式应对和遏制存在问题的行为。在暂停期间,根据所施加暂停的范围,该人员可能无法继续招揽投资者、产生或促进进一步投资,或以其他方式参与EB-5项目,无论是部分参与还是受限参与。例如,区域中心可能被暂停提交项目申请或接受新的区域中心投资者。任何暂停自作出决定之日起生效,并持续USCIS规定的期限。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)(3)。拟议规则总体上将把关于在暂停期间暂缓审理某些申请的现行政策法典化,但将为暂缓受理、驳回或拒绝与被暂停的区域中心或新商业企业(NCE)或创造就业实体(JCE)相关的申请提供更统一的标准。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)(3)(ii-iii)。
Under the proposed rule, USCIS could suspend any person from participating in the EB-5 program. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(3). DHS proposes that suspension means temporarily disallowing some or all forms of participation in the EB-5 program by the suspended person. See proposed 8 CFR 204.401, Suspend. Suspensions may be time or violation-limited sanctions to address and contain problematic behaviors in a generally constructive manner. During a period of suspension and depending on the scope of suspension imposed, the person may not be able to continue to solicit investors, generate or promote further investments, or otherwise participate in the EB-5 program, either in part or with restrictions. For example, a regional center could be suspended from filing project applications or accepting new regional center investors. Any suspension would take effect as of the date of the determination and last for the period specified by USCIS. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(3). The proposed rule would generally codify existing policy on holding the adjudication of certain applications and petitions during the period of suspension but would provide more uniform parameters for holding, rejecting, or denying applications associated with suspended regional centers or NCEs or JCEs. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(3)(ii-iii).
三、取消资格(禁止参与)
c. Debarments
国土安全部拟议规定,取消资格处分将使相关人员无法参与EB-5项目,且无法根据USCIS的决定永久或临时重新申请。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.401,“取消资格”定义。取消资格处分可以是临时性的,也可以是永久性的,但无论哪种情形,均将导致该人员终止参与EB-5项目。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)(5)。所有取消资格处分均将包括或先行终止该人员对EB-5项目的参与,且将适用于需要采取更长期解决方案以维护项目诚信的情形,包括临时或永久将其从EB-5项目中移除。
DHS proposes that debarments preclude a person's participation in the EB-5 program without the ability for reapplication either permanently or temporarily as determined by USCIS. See proposed 8 CFR 204.401, Debar. Debarments could be temporary or permanent, but in either case would result in the end of the person's participation in the EB-5 program. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(5). All debarments would include or be preceded by ending the person's participation in the EB-5 program and would occur under circumstances requiring longer term solutions to safeguard program integrity, including temporary or permanent removal from the EB-5 program.
临时性债务禁令将终止相关人员的参与资格,但允许其在美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)规定的期限之后重新申请。见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)(5)(iii)。美国公民及移民服务局将在规定期限内将被临时禁业的人员从任何已批准区域中心或注册推广人名单中移除。如果禁业为临时性,美国公民及移民服务局将在其向受影响方发出的制裁通知中说明禁业期限。见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(f)(1)。例如,国土安全部(DHS)可能基于与不遵守联邦和州证券法有关的相关限时禁令而实施临时性禁业。因违反证券合规要求而可能受到制裁的相关各方范围相当广泛,包括部长认定的参与区域中心或新商业企业活动的任何人员。《移民与国籍法》(INA)第203(b)(5)(G)和(I)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)和(I)。此外,因不遵守联邦和州证券法而可能受到制裁的违规行为包括任何法院发出的临时或永久命令、判决或裁定,以及美国证券交易委员会(SEC)或州证券监管机构发出的最终命令。《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(I)(iv)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(I)(iv)。鉴于可能受影响的当事方数量众多,且其他州和联邦监管机构发出的命令和判决的时间跨度各异,并且鉴于《监管影响分析》(RIA)要求建立分级制裁机制,国土安全部认为,在这些及其他类似情形下,临时性禁业可能是一种适当的制裁手段,其严厉程度低于永久性禁业。见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(b)。
A temporary debarment would end the person's participation while permitting reapplication after a timeframe specified by USCIS. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(5)(iii). USCIS would remove temporarily debarred persons from any list of approved regional centers or registered promoters for the specified timeframe. If the debarment is temporary, USCIS would provide the length of the bar in its sanctions notice to the affected party. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(f)(1). For example, DHS may impose a temporary debarment based on a related time-limited injunction due to noncompliance with Federal and State securities laws. The range of associated parties that could be sanctioned for securities noncompliance is quite broad, including any persons involved in the regional center's or new commercial enterprise's activities, as determined by the Secretary. INA secs. 203(b)(5)(G) and (I), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G) and (I). Further, potential violations subject to sanction for noncompliance with Federal and State securities laws include temporary or permanent orders, judgements, or decrees of any court, final orders issued by the SEC or State securities regulator. INA secs. 203(b)(5)(I)(iv), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(I)(iv). Due to the number of possible parties affected and varied time horizons of orders and judgements issued by other State and Federal regulators, and due to the RIA requirement for the establishment of graduated sanctions, DHS believes that temporary debarments may be an appropriate sanctions tool short of imposing a permanent bar in these and other similar circumstances. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(b).
《移民与国籍法》要求,凡美国公民及移民服务局自由裁量认定某个人或组织曾知情参与导致区域中心、新商业企业或创造就业实体因涉及公共安全、国家安全、欺诈、欺骗、故意重大虚假陈述或刑事滥用等原因而被终止的任何行为的,均应永久禁止该个人或组织参与EB-5项目。《移民与国籍法》第203(b)(5)(N)和(O)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(N)和(O)。美国公民及移民服务局将无限期地将被永久禁业的实体从任何已批准区域中心或注册推广人名单中移除。
The INA requires the permanent debarment of any individual or organization from participating in the EB-5 program where USCIS determines, in its discretion, that the individual or organization was a knowing participant in any conduct that led to the termination of a regional center, new commercial enterprise, or job-creating entity for reasons relating to public safety, national security, fraud, deceit, intentional material misrepresentation, or criminal misuse. INA secs. 203(b)(5)(N) and (O), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(N) and (O). USCIS would remove permanently debarred entities from any list of approved regional centers or registered promoters indefinitely.
美国公民及移民服务局将基于实际知情或推定知情以及直接或间接参与两方面因素,来认定某人是否为知情参与者。见拟议的8 CFR 204.432(b)及204.433(b)。因此,如果某人知道其参与被禁止行为属于违法行为,或者该人本应知道其参与被禁止行为属于违法行为(例如,基于其在相关实体中的职位或关系),美国公民及移民服务局将认定该人为知情参与者。此外,如果某人直接参与被禁止行为,或通过中介人或代表间接参与被禁止行为,或因实际知情或推定知情却未行使其职权阻止被禁止行为发生,美国公民及移民服务局也将认定该人为知情参与者。例如,如果某EB-5实体的高管在实际知情或推定知情的情况下,未能终止代表该EB-5实体从事与EB-5项目相关欺诈行为的雇员或其他代理人的职务,美国公民及移民服务局将对该高管予以禁业处理。
USCIS would base a determination that a person was a knowing participant on actual or constructive knowledge and either direct or indirect participation. See proposed 8 CFR 204.432(b) and 204.433(b). Consequently, USCIS would consider any person to being a knowing participant if that person knew that his or her participation in the prohibited conduct was unlawful or if that person should have known that his or her participation in the prohibited conduct was unlawful (for example, based on their position or relationship with the relevant entity). Moreover, USCIS would consider a person to be a knowing participant if that person participated directly in the prohibited conduct or indirectly in the prohibited conduct such as through an intermediary or representative or by having actual or constructive knowledge of the prohibited conduct and failing to exercise his or her authority to prevent the prohibited conduct from occurring. For example, USCIS would debar an executive of an EB-5 entity with actual or constructive knowledge who fails to terminate an employee or other agent that is engaging in fraud on behalf of the EB-5 entity in connection with the EB-5 program.
d. 终止
d. Terminations
如上文关于相关定义的讨论所述,国土安全部(DHS)根据所终止参与资格的实体类型不同,对其终止权限作出不同的解释。由于国土安全部仅指定区域中心(而非新商业企业(NCE)或创造就业实体(JCE)),国土安全部将其对区域中心的终止权限解释为仅适用于按照该术语的历史惯例和用法终止区域中心的指定,因此国土安全部提议仅对区域中心施加终止作为一种制裁措施。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.431(d)(4)。国土安全部提议,被终止的区域中心不得向寻求移民投资者身份分类的投资者募集资本。参见拟议的8 CFR 204.401,术语“终止”。另一方面,《移民与国籍法》(INA)也授权终止新商业企业或创造就业实体在EB-5项目中的参与资格。参见INA第203(b)(5)(H)(iv)条、第(N)(iii)条和第(O)(ii)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(H)(iv)、(N)(iii)、(O)(ii)。首先,国土安全部并不像INA中对区域中心所设想的那样,或按照历史惯例,为新商业企业或创造就业实体指定项目参与资格。此外,INA的这些条款并未区分“终止”一词更具体地适用于区域中心指定情形的用法,与可能同样导致新商业企业或创造就业实体终止其在EB-5项目中参与资格的其他类型制裁(例如除名)之间的区别。参见INA第203(b)(5)(G)(iii)(II)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii)(II)(授权以除名方式终止(第40728页)非区域中心主体在EB-5项目中的参与资格,同时将“终止”一词的使用严格限制于区域中心的指定情形)。国土安全部还指出,根据INA第203(b)(5)(M)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M)的投资者保护措施,仅在区域中心被终止或新商业企业或创造就业实体被除名时才会触发。参见INA第203(b)(5)(M)(ii)(I)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M)(ii)(I)(“在区域中心终止的情形下”),以及INA第203(b)(5)(M)(ii)(II)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M)(ii)(I)(“在新商业企业或创造就业实体被除名的情形下”)。因此,若新商业企业或创造就业实体的终止与除名有所区别,则不会触发INA第203(b)(5)(M)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M)项下的这些投资者保护措施,国土安全部认为这将与INA第203(b)(5)(M)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M)其余条款为“善意投资者”提供保护的规定相悖。因此,国土安全部将其终止新商业企业或创造就业实体项目参与资格的权限解释为等同于除名,这体现在前文所述的拟议定义及相应配套规则中。据此,根据本拟议规则,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将有权因拟议8 CFR 204.431(b)中所列任何违规行为而终止区域中心在区域中心项目中的参与资格。监管影响分析(RIA)要求,如果新商业企业违反有关EB-5资本再部署的任何要求(INA第203(b)(5)(F)(v)(II)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(v)(II)),或者区域中心不同意或蓄意企图阻碍国土安全部的审计(INA第203(b)(5)(E)(vii)(III)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(E)(vii)(III),另见拟议8 CFR 204.431(b)(3)),或者区域中心未在诚信基金费到期后90天内缴纳所需费用(INA第203(b)(5)(J)(iv)(II)条,8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(J)(iv)(II);另见拟议8 CFR 204.431(b)(9)),则须终止该区域中心的指定。
As discussed above in connection with relevant definitions, DHS interprets its termination authority differently depending on which entity's participation is being terminated. Since DHS only designates regional centers (and not NCEs or JCEs), DHS interprets its termination authority for regional centers as applying only to end the designation of a regional center in line with historic practice and usage of this term, and DHS accordingly proposes to impose terminations as a sanction only on regional centers. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(d)(4). DHS proposes that a terminated regional center may not solicit capital from an investor seeking classification as an immigrant investor. See proposed 8 CFR 204.401, Terminate. On the other hand, the INA also provides authority to terminate the participation of NCEs or JCEs in the EB-5 program. See INA secs. 203(b)(5)(H)(iv), (N)(iii), and (O)(ii), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(H)(iv), (N)(iii), (O)(ii). As an initial matter, DHS does not designate NCEs or JCEs for participation in the program the same as is contemplated for regional centers under the INA or in line with historic practices. Moreover, these provisions of the INA do not distinguish between the more specific usage of termination as it applies to a regional center's designation versus other types of sanctions that could apply to NCEs or JCEs that would similarly end their participation in the EB-5 program, such as debarment. Cf. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(G)(iii)(II), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(G)(iii)(II) (authorizing debarment to end the participation of ( printed page 40728) non-regional center persons in the EB-5 program while limiting usage of the term termination specifically just to a regional center's designation). DHS also notes that the investor protections under section 203(b)(5)(M) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M) trigger only upon either the termination of a regional center or debarment of a NCE or JCE. See INA sec. 203(b)(5)(M)(ii)(I), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M)(ii)(I) (“in the case of the termination of a regional center”), and INA sec. 203(b)(5)(M)(ii)(II), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M)(ii)(I) (“in the case of the debarment of a new commercial enterprise or job-creating entity”). Consequently, termination of a NCE or JCE that would be distinct from debarment would not trigger these investor protections under section 203(b)(5)(M) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M), which DHS believes would be contrary to the remaining provisions of section 203(b)(5)(M) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(M), which provide protections to “good faith investors.” DHS therefore interprets its authority to terminate the participation of NCEs or JCEs in the program as tantamount to debarment, which is reflected in the proposed definitions and accompanying rules discussed previously. Accordingly, under this proposed rule, USCIS would have the ability to terminate a regional center from participation in the Regional Center Program for any of the violations in proposed 8 CFR 204.431(b). The RIA requires termination of the regional center's designation where the new commercial enterprise violates any of the requirements of redeployment of EB-5 capital (INA sec. 203(b)(5)(F)(v)(II), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(F)(v)(II)), if the regional center does not consent to or deliberately attempts to impede a DHS audit (INA sec. 203(b)(5)(E)(vii)(III), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(E)(vii)(III), see also proposed 8 CFR 204.431(b)(3)), or if the regional center does not make the required Integrity Fund Fee payment within 90 days of its due date (INA sec. 203(b)(5)(J)(iv)(II), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(J)(iv)(II); see also proposed 8 CFR 204.431(b)(9)).
e. 制裁程序
e. Sanctions Process
Under this proposed rule, any sanction could be appealed to the Administrative Appeals Office. See proposed 8 CFR 204.431(h). DHS considered how to provide maximum effect to a sanction, while also allowing a sanctioned person the opportunity to exhaust all administrative remedies. Particularly, as related to monetary penalties, DHS considered whether any such penalty would be due immediately or should be delayed pending the filing (or subsequent outcome) of an appeal. DHS also considered requiring any sanctioned person to pay a percentage of any monetary penalty upon receipt of a sanction notice, with the balance coming due if any appeal is dismissed, to deter frivolous appeal filings solely to delay the effective date of a sanction, while also preserving the right of the sanctioned person to file an appeal. Similarly, DHS considered borrowing an approach used by the Internal Revenue Service where, if an appeal is filed, interest accrues from the date any monetary penalty comes due, which would then be payable at the conclusion of an appeal, if such appeal is dismissed.[94] If the appeal is sustained, then the monetary penalty and accrued interest would be dismissed.
DHS is seeking public input on the process USCIS should implement as it relates to sanctions and the right of appeal, particularly how DHS can balance the right of appeal with ensuring the effectiveness of the sanctions proposed under 8 CFR 204.431.
9. Audits
The INA requires DHS to audit each regional center at least once every 5 years. INA sec. 203(b)(5)(E)(vii)(II), 8 U.S.C. 1153(b)(5)(E)(vii)(II). DHS proposes that USCIS conduct these audits, and USCIS is currently doing so according to the Generally Accepted Government Auditing Standards (GAGAS) to the extent practicable as determined by USCIS. See proposed 8 CFR 204.430(a) and (b). DHS considered using Generally Accepted Auditing Standards (GAAS), but GAAS would only provide an opinion on the reliability of the annual financial statements prepared by the regional center and would not provide the opinion needed on the performance of the regional center.
Audits permit USCIS the ability to reach a conclusion on the performance of the regional center, including reviews of the regional center's financial and program performance, as well as determining whether the regional center is effectively managing its operations under the Regional Center Program and properly pooling regional center investor capital to create jobs.
USCIS would use the results of an audit to evaluate whether the regional center is continuing to operate consistent with its designation. See proposed 8 CFR 204.430(b). To do so, USCIS would not only review all records the regional center previously submitted to USCIS, but also have the ability to request information from or conduct interviews or site visits to any new commercial enterprise or job-creating entity(ies) associated with the regional center. Id.
